{{nihongo|'''Otowatatsumi Shrine'''|乙和多都美神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} located in {{ill|Izuhara|ja|厳原町|ko|이즈하라정|qid=Q11410123}}, {{ill|Tsushima, Nagasaki|ar|تسوشيما (ناغاساكي)|az|Tsuşima (Naqasaki)|azb|تسوشیما، ناقاساکی|ca|Tsushima (Nagasaki)|ce|Цусима (Нагасаки)|de|Tsushima (Nagasaki)|es|Tsushima (Nagasaki)|fa|تسوشیما، ناگاساکی|fi|Tsushima (Nagasaki)|fr|Tsushima (Nagasaki)|it|Tsushima (Nagasaki)|ja|対馬市|ko|쓰시마시 (나가사키현)|mzn|تسوشیما، ناگازاکی|nl|Tsushima (Nagasaki)|no|Tsushima (Nagasaki)|pl|Tsushima (Nagasaki)|pt|Tsushima (cidade)|ro|Tsushima, Nagasaki|ru|Цусима (Нагасаки)|sv|Tsushima, Nagasaki|tg|Тсушима|tl|Tsusyima, Nagasaki|tr|Tsushima, Nagasaki|tt|Цусима (Нагасаки)|uk|Цушіма (Нагасакі)|ur|تسوشیما، ناگاساکی|vi|Tsushima, Nagasaki|war|Tsushima, Nagasaki|zh|對馬市|zh_classical|對馬市|zh_yue|對馬|qid=Q991032}}, {{ill|Nagasaki Prefecture|Q169376|qid=Q169376}}. It is considered a candidate site (ronsha) for the Shikinaisha Watatsumi Shrine recorded in the '{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932}}'. {{nihongo|'''Otowatatsumi Shrine'''|乙和多都美神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Tsushima]].

== Overview ==
The date of establishment is unknown; however, according to shrine tradition, {{ill|Empress Jingū|Q232803|qid=Q232803}} moored her ship at this location and enshrined the deity.

It is the only “Watatsumi Shrine” in {{ill|Shimoagata district|ja|下県郡|ko|시모아가타군|zh|下縣郡|qid=Q10868678}} (the {{ill|Watazumi Shrine|ja|和多都美神社|ko|와타즈미 신사|simple|Watazumi Shrine|qid=Q18457651}} area was formerly in {{ill|Kamiagata district|Q10868208|qid=Q10868208}}), and in the *Tsushima Shrine Gazetteer* it is recorded as “Wadatsumi Daimyōjin.”<ref> Shikinaisha Research Association, *Report of the Shikinaisha Survey* ({{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Kōgakkan University}} Press)</ref>

In the full text of the *Tsushima Shrine Gazetteer*, the description is no different from that of an ordinary village tutelary shrine; no distinctive characteristics as a Watatsumi Shrine are noted, nor is there any indication of traditions associated with official shrines.<ref> Shikinaisha Research Association, *Report of the Shikinaisha Survey* (Kōgakkan University Press)</ref>
